Vote - AcceptText - Yes I think that the reading Μέλανο̣υ̣ν̣ is an improvement. Μελανοῦς is clear in lin28 so we would expect Μέλανο̣υ̣ν̣. The form of the omikron is flattened and diagonal (thus more like an alpha), but there are other examples of omikron flattened, though usually less diagonal. The correction suggested seems not to have been noticed elsewhere or to have appeared in the Berichtigungsliste.
Submit - l. 13: I think the reading should be Μέλανο̣υ̣ν̣, not Μελανᾶ̣ν̣ (person is also attested in l. 28)
